disposition_reason: EFSA FEEDAP opinion on environmental safety of molybdenum (and cobalt) feed additives at maximum authorised levels; background P90 values and modeled soil concentrations, no food occurrence.
disposition_locator: Section 3.2 and Table 3 (p. 7); Section 3.2.2 and Table 4 (p. 8)

study.method: FERA model PECsoil vs P90 natural background

regulatory_or_exposure: EU authorised use: sodium molybdate dihydrate for sheep, maximum 2.5 mg Mo/kg complete feed (Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/1965) (p. 7)
Natural background P90: soil 1.81 mg/kg dw (FOREGS, n = 840); groundwater 2.14 µg/L (EGG, n = 8841); freshwater 1.07 µg/L (n = 807); freshwater sediment 1.89 mg/kg dw (n = 848) (Table 3, p. 7)
PECsoil after 1 year at maximum level 30.3 to 34.4 µg Mo/kg soil dw; below 10% of background; years to double background 53 to 60 (p. 8, Table 4)
Conclusion: use at the maximum authorised level in complete feed is safe for the environment (p. 8)
